basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and history enthusiast, I spend my free time exploring open-world RPGs like Assassin's Creed and Total War. Originally from the UK, I work as a junior analyst at a consulting firm, diving deep into data during the day and virtual worlds by night. I am single and typically online during late evenings and weekends, often found discussing game lore or seeking solutions for in-game bugs. Besides gaming, I have a keen interest in Norse mythology and often browse subreddits related to historical cultures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in History and a passion for gaming, I often blend my academic knowledge with gaming experiences. I have self-taught skills in data analysis, which I apply in both my professional life and when dissecting intricate game mechanics.
